title: Liu2022 – eldBETA SSVEP benchmark dataset for elderly population
description: The eldBETA dataset comprises 64-channel EEG recordings from 100 healthy elderly participants (aged 51-81 years) performing a 9-target steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. Using joint frequency and phase modulation stimuli with frequencies ranging from 8.0 to 12.0 Hz, the dataset contains 7 sessions per subject with visual feedback in a speller paradigm. This benchmark dataset is designed to support the development and evaluation of SSVEP-BCI systems for aging populations.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 1000 Hz using a 64-channel Synamps2 system (Neuroscan) with standard 10-05 montage referenced to Cz. Participants completed 7 blocks of 9 trials each, with each trial consisting of a 4-second target cue followed by 5 seconds of SSVEP stimulation and 1 second rest. Nine SSVEP targets were presented in a 3×3 matrix using joint frequency and phase modulation with frequencies from 8.0 to 12.0 Hz (0.5 Hz step).
